paper.title: Lifelong restriction of dietary valine has sex-specific benefits for health and lifespan in mice

organism.source_quote: valine restriction (Val-R) improves metabolic health in C57BL/6J mice

strain.source_quote: valine restriction (Val-R) improves metabolic health in C57BL/6J mice

sex.source_quote: extends the lifespan of male, but not female, mice by 23%

type.source_quote: we test the effect of lifelong restriction of the BCAA valine on healthy aging

agent.source_quote: we test the effect of lifelong restriction of the BCAA valine on healthy aging

age_at_start.source_quote: we test the effect of lifelong restriction of the BCAA valine on healthy aging

direction.source_quote: extends the lifespan of male, but not female, mice by 23%

experiments.notes: Lifespan extended in males. The abstract gives the size as an unqualified '23%' without naming median, mean or maximum, so every numeric lifespan field is null: this project does not substitute one statistic for another. The figure is recorded here instead - +23% in males, statistic unspecified. See the NOTES.md entry of 2026-08-11 on the unqualified-percentage gap. Healthspan, not lifespan: Val-R promotes leanness and glycemic control across ages and reduces frailty, cancer prevalence and senescent cell burden in multiple tissues in both sexes, and reduces glial activation in the brain in a male-specific manner. None of those is a lifespan result and none is recorded as one. Associated molecular finding, not a claimed mechanism: the abstract identifies a Val-R-induced male-specific increase in mitochondrial respiration, but does not state that it mediates the lifespan effect, so mechanism is null - contrast Eisenberg 2009, where autophagy is called 'crucial for' the effect. Excluded as other work: the isoleucine result is the authors' PRIOR paper ('we recently found...'), and the claim that BCAA restriction extends healthspan and lifespan is background literature. Neither is a finding of this study; neither appears as a record, a value or a source_quote. dose and sample_size are null because the abstract states neither.
